Evidence & scope

Scoped methods, data-collection or experiment claims were read from the exact pinned preprint version by separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI invocations. The full cited contexts, including conditions and model/table identities, are bound to approved observations; actual partial/full/unread scopes are retained in review records. This is not a complete-paper, latest-version, corpus, proof, labor, supplier-performance or experiment-reproduction audit. Work and version remain distinct and contribute at most one reviewed paper work.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Minority Reports: Balancing Cost and Quality in Ground Truth Data Annotation (2504.09341v1) · paper method: The pruning rule retains assignments involving unseen workers or tasks; otherwise it prunes when estimated minority-report probability exceeds a fixed threshold.

cohort8.claim.minority.cold-start-retain

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Prediction uses previously observed assignments and is recalibrated over time; a pruning decision is not a general worker competence judgment.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Minority Reports: Balancing Cost and Quality in Ground Truth Data Annotation (2504.09341v1) · paper method: Simulation quality is measured by comparing post-pruning majority votes against the counterfactual unpruned majority, using yes/no accuracy and F1.

cohort8.claim.minority.evaluation-reference

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Prune rate counts removed repeats from 1,035,491 original repeats; the denominator differs from 196,446 annotation tasks. No prospective field labor savings are established by the simulation.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Minority Reports: Balancing Cost and Quality in Ground Truth Data Annotation (2504.09341v1) · paper method: The paper defines a minority report as an annotator response that differs from the final majority-vote consensus for an image-crop question.

  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • “Incorrect” is operationalized relative to consensus here; minority perspectives are not independently proven false by this definition.

Minority Reports: Balancing Cost and Quality in Ground Truth Data Annotation (2504.09341v1) · paper method: The discussion cautions that RLHF ranked preferences can have high variability without a clear majority or a single notion of ground truth.
